title: juxtapose config
description: juxtapose.config.json, .juxtaposerc.json, or the `juxtapose` key in package.json.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors.

id.description: Stable id; used as the story id and for file names.

params.description: Per-story capture options: `parameters.juxtapose` in Storybook, `meta.juxtapose` in Ladle.

mode.description: Exact SHA-256 comparison (default), or opt-in Pixelmatch visual equivalence after a hash mismatch.

threshold.description: Pixelmatch perceived color-distance tolerance. Default 0.05. Ignored in exact mode. Antialias differences are excluded; every remaining differing pixel fails.

shared.description: Reuse renderer processes between stories. Default true. Baseline mismatches retry with a cache pulse, then a fresh renderer.

clearResourceCache.description: Clear Blink resource memory cache before reused-renderer navigation. Default false; ignored when shared is false. HTTP cache is retained.

mask.description: CSS selectors to paint over before the shutter: a solid box over each match's bounding box. For a clock or a random avatar; prefer stubbing the input.

items.description: A CSS selector. Playwright-only syntax (`text=`) is refused.

delay.description: Fixed extra wait after settle, in ms; last resort. Prefer waitForSelector.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for async content juxtapose can't detect: capture once this CSS selector matches.

captureTimeout.description: Max ms to wait for render-ready before capturing anyway. Default 2000.

settle.description: How long to wait for the page to finish before capture. Layered: project config, then the story, then `stories` overrides, then the command.

timeout.description: The cap on the wait, in ms, from 1 to 60000. Default 1500. At the cap the page is captured anyway and the result is flagged settle-timeout.

ready.description: Also wait until the page calls `window.__juxtapose.ready()`. Default false.

network.description: Which requests the settle wait counts.

ignore.description: URL patterns never counted as pending, added to the built-in list (type:WebSocket, type:EventSource, type:Ping, type:Prefetch). A pattern is a URL glob, a `type:<ResourceType>`, or both.

require.description: URL patterns that must each see a matching request complete before capture. Wins over `ignore`.

network.description: Which requests the page may make. Layered like `settle`; only values known before navigation apply.

anyOf.description: `block` fails requests to origins other than the page's own (the story URL's origin) at once. Same as `{ default }`.
Per resource type actions for third-party requests, each overriding `default` for that type.

default.description: For third-party requests no type entry covers. `placeholder` is not valid here; it needs a resource type. Default `allow`.

images.description: Third-party images (CDP resource type Image). `placeholder` answers with a fixed 64x64 gray PNG, the same bytes every time.

frames.description: Third-party sub-frame documents (iframes). `placeholder` answers with a fixed empty HTML document.

media.description: Third-party audio and video (CDP resource type Media). `placeholder` blocks: there is no stand-in for media.

rules.description: URL rules checked before `external`, in order; the first match wins. They match any URL, including the Storybook's own origin. Story rules are checked before project rules.

items.description: One URL rule: the first rule that matches a request decides it.

match.description: A URL glob, a `type:<ResourceType>`, or both: the same pattern syntax as `settle.network.ignore`. A glob starting with `/` matches the URL path.

action.description: `allow`, `block`, or `placeholder` (a fixed image or empty frame; any other request is blocked instead, and `placeholder` on a `type:` that can't have one is an error).

freeze.description: Make time and randomness deterministic before any page script runs. Layered field by field like `settle`; only values known before navigation apply.

clock.description: Start `Date`, `Date.now()` and `Intl.DateTimeFormat` at a fixed instant, advancing as timers fire (or after 10,000 consecutive clock reads to let synchronous waits finish). `true` uses 2024-01-01T12:00:00Z; an ISO 8601 date or date-time with `Z` or an offset picks another; `false` (default) keeps the real clock.

random.description: Seed `Math.random`, `crypto.getRandomValues` and `crypto.randomUUID`, so each page draws the same sequence every run. Default false.

threshold.description: pixelmatch colour-distance threshold, 0 to 1. Default 0.1. Tunes the reported diff in exact mode; comparison.threshold controls visual equivalence.

minDiffPercent.description: Mismatch percentage below which diff highlighting is suppressed, 0 to 100. Default 0. Reporting only; never changes pass/fail.

viewport.description: The capture size, in CSS pixels.

animations.description: CSS animations during capture. Default 'disabled' so spinners don't flake; 'play' lets them run (for stories testing animation).

captureAfterPlay.description: Screenshot after the story's play function, not at first render.

liveCapture.description: false excludes this story from watch-mode recapture while leaving normal runs alone. Default true.

variants.description: Named capture variants, each captured, judged and approved on its own under `<story id>__<name>`. `false` opts out of a project-wide variant of that name.

anyOf.description: A named capture variant, captured, judged and approved on its own under `<story id>__<name>`. `skip` is not an option; set the variant to false instead.

buildDir.description: The built static workbench, relative to the project root. jux serves it for the length of the run. The `--build-dir` flag overrides it.

origin.description: Capture a running or deployed workbench at this URL instead of a build. The `--origin` flag overrides it.

concurrency.description: Parallel pages. Default 8. Past your core count, contention slows captures down.

warmSwitch.description: Switch stories in place instead of navigating. ~4x faster, but doesn't reproduce cold-load pixels exactly, so a story's verdict can depend on queue order. Default false.

clearResourceCache.description: Clear Blink resource memory cache before reused-renderer navigation. Default false; ignored when shared is false. HTTP cache is retained.

freshRenderer.description: Legacy inverse of renderer.shared: true uses fresh renderers, false uses sharing with bounded cache-pulse and fresh retries for baseline mismatches. Prefer renderer.shared. Conflicting explicit project values are rejected.

recheck.description: Which stories the run captures a second time, so approve can tell a stable capture from a flaky one. "changed" (default): new and failing stories. "new": new stories only. "off": none; `jux approve` takes the confirming capture instead. Stories that pass their first capture need no recheck. Fresh history retries run independently of this setting. Approval always confirms fresh. The `--recheck` flag overrides it.

storyTimeout.description: Budget for capturing one story, navigation through encode, in ms (whole number from 1000). Default 60000. A story that uses it all fails once with an error naming the step it was stuck in.
